 A former SNL writer steps up for a seventh time this evening.
 By Chris Phelan Nov 14, 2026, 9:00 AM ET John Mulaney Just Wants to Promote SNL Now Playing 1:44 Current Preview John Mulaney Just Wants to Promote SNL 1:20 Current Preview John Mulaney and Phoebe Bridgers Call Ben Marshall a Temu Ron Weasley 1:47 Web Exclusive Behind the Sketch: Birthday Girl Share this on Reddit Share this on Facebook Share this on X Share this by Email Share this by SMS Copy link Add us on Google Key Takeaways
 A new episode of Saturday Night Live airs tonight, November 14, 2026, live on NBC and Peacock at 11:30 p.m. ET, with streaming available on Peacock the following day.
 John Mulaney returns as Host for the seventh time, continuing his long relationship with SNL after serving as a writer from 2008 to 2013 and co-creating the iconic Stefon character with Bill Hader.
 Phoebe Bridgers is the Musical Guest, returning after previous SNL appearances in 2021 and 2023 while touring in support of her latest album, Lost Weekend.
 Saturday Night Live is on fire: Last week's November 7 episode featuring Druski nabbed the highest ratings of Season 52 so far, with 5.6 million viewers tuning in to witness the viral social media comedian make his Studio 8H debut.
 How to Watch
 Watch Saturday Night Live  Saturdays at 11:30 p.m. ET on NBC and next day on Peacock.
 Stream Now on Druski shined in sketches like "Dru Can See Everything" and "Bubu Mobile," proving his internet sketch comedy career definitely translates to the bright lights of SNL . 
 Another Saturday has arrived — and what should you expect in tonight's November 14 edition? A Host with plenty of SNL experience both in front of and behind the camera is returning for the seventh time in his career. Read on for details.

 Is there a new episode of SNL tonight, November 14?
 Yes.
 The sixth episode of Saturday Night Live 's 52nd season airs tonight, live coast-to-coast at 11:30 p.m. ET/10:30 p.m. CT/8:30 p.m. PT on NBC and Peacock, headlined by a returning Host. Stream new episodes next-day on Peacock.
 RELATED: Watch All of Druski's SNL Sketches & Monologue from November 7, 2026 
 Who is the SNL Host for the November 14 episode?
 John Mulaney.
 (Ego Nwodim) and Daniel (John Mulaney) appear on Saturday Night Live Season 44 Episode 14 during the "Cha Cha Slide" sketch on Saturday, March 2, 2019.
 Photo: Will Heath/NBC Mulaney was an SNL writer from 2008 to 2013. During that time, he created the iconic Stefon character , played by co-creator Bill Hader. Stefon made many appearances on "Weekend Update," with Hader often breaking character due to Mulaney constantly changing the cast members' cue cards in between dress rehearsal and the live show.
 Making his hosting debut in 2018, Mulaney entered the Five-Timers Club in 2022. He enjoys a successful career in stand-up comed, has starred in shows like Big Mouth, and hosted the streaming talk show series Everybody's Live with John Mulaney in 2025. Mulaney is in the cast of the 2026 biopic Madden starring Nicolas Cage.

 Here are all the times John Mulaney has headlined SNL :
 Season 43 – April 14, 2018 
 Season 44 – March 2, 2019 
 Season 45 – February 29, 2020 
 Season 46 – October 31, 2020 
 Season 47 – February 26, 2022 
 Season 50 – November 2, 2024 
 Season 52 – November 14, 2026 
 Talk about staying busy: Nobody has hosted SNL more in the last ten years than John Mulaney. 
 RELATED: John Mulaney's "Diner Lobster" SNL Sketch Is a Genius Les Misérables Parody 
 Who is the Musical Guest for tonight's November 14 SNL episode?
 Phoebe Bridgers.
 Phoebe Bridgers during The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon Season 13 Episode 128.
 Photo: Todd Owyoung/NBC Bridgers is a four-time Grammy winner currently touring in support of her latest album, Lost Weekend , and recently announced more tour dates across the United States through May 2027. Lost Weekend 's lead single, "Lost Boys," climbed to the number-one spot on Billboard 's Adult Alternative Airplay chart on August 29, 2026.
 You may have seen the star on the silver screen lately, too: Bridgers co-stars alongside Robert Pattinson and Skyler Gizondo in the 2026 Chris Hansen biopic Primetime .
 RELATED: Every Musical Guest of SNL Season 52   
 Bridgers debuted as an SNL Musical Guest in Season 46 on February 6, 2021, performing her hits "Kyoto" and "I Know The End." The singer-songwriter capped her second performance of the evening by smashing her guitar to pieces .
 She subsequently appeared as part of indie supergroup Boygenius in Season 49 on November 11, 2023, performing alongside Julien Baker and Lucy Dacus.

 NBC Turns 100 This Year! On November 15, 1926, NBC aired its first broadcast — and for 100 years, the network has helped define news , sports , and entertainment . Whether you’re starting your mornings with TODAY , laughing on weekends with SNL , or catching the big game on Sundays , NBC has been part of people’s lives for generations. Now in 2026, we're celebrating a century of shared moments, memories, and milestones. A century together. Stay tuned to NBC this fall for stories honoring the shows, characters, and moments you love — both past and present. Because after 100 years, we’re only getting started. Don't forget to stream all your NBC favorites on Peacock right now.
